candidates.rationale: Affirms that we can do all things through Christ who strengthens us, encouraging perseverance when facing unfamiliar challenges.
God promises to strengthen and help us when we're afraid or overwhelmed by new situations, assuring us not to fear.
Encourages diligent pursuit of wisdom and understanding with the promise that God grants knowledge to those who seek it earnestly.
Commands courage and confidence in unfamiliar territory, reminding us that God is with us wherever we go.
Reminds us that God has given a spirit of power, love, and self-discipline rather than timidity when facing new tasks.
